critical_code_review_comments: Members listing applies campus filter (correct), so a guest created without a `location_id` will not appear in /api/members?kind=guest for an admin with active_campus_id set. Backend behavior is correct; just a documentation note for downstream UI/import flows that must pass `location_id` when creating guests.
/api/members response is enveloped ({members, total}) — the test helper normalises it; if any frontend code still treats it as a bare list it would break (none observed).
seed_data_creation: Each test creates throwaway guests with prefix CI-DUAL-/CI-DEL- and a single CI-PASS2-EVT-* event; all are cleaned up by fixture teardown. A pre-test sweep removed 2 orphan CI-* mirrors from a prior partial test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pass 2 features (volunteer auto-generate + guests/parents unification) are fully green. Backend 31/31 pytest (15 new + 16 smoke). The new test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration115_pass2_volunteers_unify.py and can be re-run safely. Frontend testid contract verified: auto-generate-shifts-btn, autogen-event-select, autogen-confirm-btn, autogen-replace-checkbox, autogen-add-role-btn, unify-guests-tool, unify-guests-preview-btn, unify-guests-run-btn, unify-guests-preview (now shows '33 / 33 / 0'). Note: /api/members returns {members,total} envelope — wrap accordingly in any new tests.
rca of the issue: No production bug. One self-inflicted test issue (test had assumed admin can list any-campus members; the endpoint correctly enforces active_campus_id filtering, so test guests must be created with a matching location_id). Fixed by injecting `location_id=primary_location` into all test POST /api/guests payloads.
